title: US Treasury yields climb as oil, Fed hike bets push 10-year note to 19-year high
description: Treasury yields climbed significantly on Tuesday, reaching their highest levels since 2007.  Rising oil prices and global inflation pressures are fueling these market movements.  Investors anticipate the Federal Reserve will soon implement its first interest rate increase.  This potential hike aims to address persistent inflation concerns across the economy.  Bond markets worldwide are experiencing similar upward trends in yields.

title: Prashant Jain’s 3P India among anchors as Hero Motors raises Rs 300 crore ahead of IPO
description: Hero Motors secured Rs 300 crore from anchor investors before its upcoming IPO.  The company plans to raise Rs 1,000 crore through a mix of fresh issue and offer for sale.  Proceeds will fund debt repayment, capital expenditure, and potential acquisitions.  The automotive technology firm designs and manufactures powertrain solutions for various vehicles.  Its IPO opens for public subscription on September 16 and closes on September 18.

title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday

title: Market Trading Guide: Acme Solar,  Bharat Dynamics among 5 stock recommendations for Wednesday

title: US Treasury secretary Scott Bessent says rising bond yields due to 'global issues'
description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent emphasized global challenges as the backdrop for increasing bond yields during his comments to reporters before a congressional hearing. The event was marked by protests advocating for the cessation of sanctions against Iran, momentarily disrupting the discussion. Bessent disclosed ongoing conversations with Chinese officials about Iran's financial connections, while President Donald Trump is set to continue this dialogue with China's Xi Jinping.

title: Digital lending platform Fibe gets Sebi nod to launch IPO
description: Social Worth Technologies, the parent company of Fibe, has obtained the necessary approval from Sebi for its initial public offering. The venture aims to raise Rs 750 crore through a fresh share issue, with the funds primarily targeting the enhancement of its subsidiary’s capital for lending activities. Additionally, an offer-for-sale section will enable current shareholders to reduce their holdings.

title: New charges on UPI payments: Here's what you will be charged for stock market investments
description: UPI payments for capital market transactions will attract a nominal 0.02% Merchant Discount Rate, capped at Rs 300. The fee covers mutual funds, securities, brokers and dealers, with limited impact expected for long-term investors but greater sensitivity among frequent traders.

title: Why US markets, Dow Jones are down today: Nasdaq, S&P 500 trade lower as AI stocks steady; focus on Fed rate decision

The Federal Reserve is widely expected to raise interest rates on Wednesday as the Iran conflict pushes energy prices higher and threatens to keep inflation elevated.

title: Sebi plans shorter disaster recovery drills, stronger backup rules for exchanges

title: Sebi proposes shorter DR drills, stronger resilience norms for mkt infrastructure institutions
description: Sebi has put forth a proposal to lessen the duration of disaster recovery drills for market infrastructure institutions, reducing them from a full trading day to a minimum of four hours. This step aims to bolster operational resilience and improve data recovery processes within exchanges. The drills will be held on non-working days to replicate realistic trading conditions.
